California Institute of Technology Jet Propulsion Laboratory (JPL) is hiring an Engineering Applications Software Engineer I to develop and maintain telemetry processing software for Deep Space Network Data Services. The role supports software development, testing, documentation, and operations for DSN telemetry applications.
Aerospace

Responsibilities
The DSN Telemetry and Tracking Data Services group seeks an Engineering Applications Software Engineer I to support development of telemetry applications for the Deep Space Network (DSN) Data Services
The Engineering Applications Software Engineer I will report to cognizant development engineers to design, develop, support, test, and maintain DSN Telemetry processing software
Implement assigned change requests (CRs), new requirements (NRs), and anomaly fixes under the guidance
Work on priority Anomaly Reports (ARs) as assigned
Update JIRA as work progresses
Write and run unit tests for your code
Provide unit test input and test guidance to Testers
Help debug anomalies found during Project Interface Tests
Provide RDD (Requirements/Design Document) inputs for your assigned work
Contribute to user-facing documentation such as Software Operations Manuals (SOMs) and User Guides (UGs)
Document your work clearly, since DSN work is traceable and reviewed
Provide operations support as directed by the CDE Lead and DSN Realtime Operations
Learn the TTC subsystems and their data flows
Follow the DSN configuration management and change processes

Required
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or Mathematics, or related field with a minimum of 1 year of related experience; Master's degree in similar fields with a minimum of 0 years of related experience
Extensive understanding with one or more of the following languages: C/C++, Java, Perl or Python
Experience with XML and JSON data formats and exchange
Experience with network programming including TCP/IP, sockets and client server models
Extensive understanding with Unix-based systems
Experience working with static analysis tools
Experience developing and maintaining automated unit tests
Experience with application packaging
Experience with debugging and performance optimization
Experience in writing technical documents, including software design, delivery and test documentation, presenting at code reviews and supporting technical interchanges
Experience working in a team environment, with emphasis on strong written and verbal communication
Preferred
Relevant experience working with Telemetry processing software development teams and knowledge of SLE services, DSN interfaces, and other DSN Telemetry applications
Experience with Ground processing of CCSDS Telemetry, including diagnosing issues such as data loss and anomalous behavior
Experience and technical knowledge of scripting languages
Experience with the Solaris Operating System
Fundamental knowledge of software application design patterns and principles
Knowledge of Configuration Management practices and tools
Experience in designing and developing databases, such as TimescaleDB and PostgreSQL
Experience with HTML, and UI/UX design principles and web services, such as Django and Node.js
Knowledge of basic electrical/electronic theory
Ability to understand basic technical schematics/diagrams/drawings
Experience with Jama or TestRail
